basic_details.job_title: IIT Jammu Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Senior Engineer, Senior Project Staff and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Jammu (IIT Jammu) Senior Engineer / Project Staff Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 24 July 2026 on the official website. A total of 4 vacancies have been announced through the IIT Jammu Senior Engineer / Project Staff Recruitment 2026 for Senior Engineer (Civil), Senior Engineer (Electrical), Senior Project Staff (Environment, Construction Safety & Health Expert), and Junior Project Staff / Coordinator posts.

qualification.education_qualification: B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech. in Civil Engineering, Diploma in Civil Engineering, B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech. in Electrical Engineering, Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Bachelor's Degree, B.Tech./B.E. in Civil or Mechanical Engineering, Diploma in Civil or Mechanical Engineering
qualification.details: Senior Engineer (Civil): B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech. in Civil Engineering with minimum 15 years' experience, or Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 18 years' experience. Senior Engineer (Electrical): B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech. in Electrical Engineering with minimum 15 years' experience, or Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 18 years' experience. Senior Project Staff (Environment, Construction Safety & Health Expert): Any Bachelor's Degree with minimum 15 years' experience in Environment, Construction Safety & Health, or Diploma with minimum 18 years' relevant experience. Junior Project Staff / Coordinator: B.Tech./B.E. in Civil or Mechanical Engineering with minimum 6 years' experience, or Diploma in the relevant discipline with minimum 7 years' experience.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Jammu Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Jammu to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Jammu Senior Engineer / Project Staff posts is 08 August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Senior Engineer / Project Staff posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Senior Engineer / Project Staff positions at IIT Jammu. These include specific roles like Senior Engineer (Civil/Electrical) and Project Staff.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per the official notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post, ranging from B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech. in relevant engineering disciplines to Diploma and Bachelor's Degrees, along with significant years of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from ₹31,000 to ₹50,000 per month for Junior Project Staff/Coordinator and ₹50,000 to ₹1,00,000 per month for Senior Engineer and Senior Project Staff roles.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview. Candidates are advised to prepare well for both stages.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age limits or relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Jammu and Kashmir apply?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Jammu and Kashmir. However, it is advisable to check the official notification for any specific domicile requirements.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of IIT Jammu or the provided application link before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
